payload.text: Batch releases. A release is not cut for a minor thing on its own, and the next release carries everything open, so there is no per-issue scheduling question to put to hv. hv, 2026-09-23 09:20Z, on 0.1.8: "EVERYTHING is going into the next release. I don't want to be constantly making new releases for minor things. Just ship the lot in the next release. The end."
